# authwise_guard_cluster_trust_rule (Data Source)

A rule of a Guard cluster trust: pods of one namespace running as one service account (or `*`, any of the namespace's) may join the network with their projected service account token. The node is named `<node_name_prefix>-<pod name>`, runs on platform `KUBERNETES`, is added to `node_group`, and counts against `max_nodes` (1 to 1000; unset is 100). `ephemeral` removes a node once it has been offline an hour, or as soon as its pod leaves: for Deployment and Job pods, not StatefulSet pods, which keep their node across restarts. Changes apply to joins from now on; joined nodes keep what they joined with. Deleting a rule stops further joins; joined nodes stay. This data source reads one by its full resource name.
